## Notch 0.7.0

New since 0.6.0.

### The notch
- **Live activities:** while closed, the notch shows an incoming call, the timer, a Nearby transfer or a browser download, with its progress.
- **Idle clock:** when nothing else is going on, the notch shows the time, the microphone (muted / recording) and the battery.
- **Timer, stopwatch and Pomodoro** from the new clock button in the header.
- **Stretch reminder** (Settings › Wellbeing): counts the time you actually work. After 50 minutes it asks — start a break, later, or skip; you decide. It holds back during videos, calls and Pomodoros. Optional 20-20-20 eye reminder.
- **Phone, through KDE Connect:** incoming and missed calls, the phone's notifications (who it's from, never the message itself) and a low phone battery.
- **Privacy dots:** green while a camera is on, orange while an app records the microphone.

### App dock
- Every click on a running app works the first time (raising, minimizing and switching windows took two clicks).
- Unread badges and progress that apps report (Telegram, Thunderbird, …) show on their icons.
- Resting on an app with several windows lists them by title; click one to switch.
- Folders in the dock open as a stack of their newest files.
- Drop files on an app's icon to open them with it.
- **Trash** at the end of the dock: drop files to move them to the trash, right-click to empty it.

### Themes
- Six new themes alongside Classic and Washi: Frost, Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Lavender and Mocha, each in dark and light, picked from swatches in Settings › Appearance.

### Downloads
- **Linux:** `notch_0.7.0_amd64.deb` for Debian 13, Ubuntu 25.04 or newer (Qt 6.5+). Install with `sudo apt install ./notch_0.7.0_amd64.deb`.
- **Windows:** `Notch-0.7.0-windows-x64-setup.exe`, or the portable `.zip`.
- Optional components (OCR, KDE Connect, PDF tools on Windows) and where to get them: see the [install page](https://kepin17.github.io/olyzano-notch/#optional) or the [README](https://github.com/Kepin17/olyzano-notch#optional-components).
